fields.label: Rate
fields.description: What this person is paid, in the unit shown. Filled from the salary structure's rate when the allowance is picked; change it for this person. No row means the allowance is not paid.

fields.label: Unit
fields.description: From the allowance's kind: per month, per day present, per meal, % of initial basic, or worked out from basic.

fields.label: From Date
fields.description: Leave blank: it starts with the assignment.
